image_description: A close-up view of a sea lion resting on a rocky surface. The animal is curled up, with its head tucked towards its body. The fur appears coarse and wet, ranging from dark brown to lighter tan patches. One foreflipper is visible, appearing dark and leathery. The external ear flap is faintly visible on the side of the head.

The snout area is out of focus and angled away; whiskers are not clearly resolvable.
